event.provisional_merge_note: Counts describe deterministic connected components of MUST_MERGE evidence; the repository does not contain the authoritative upstream event builder, so no EVENT_ID or split artifact was rewritten.
event.provisional_split_count_note: These counts only collapse same-split duplicate components under the existing assignments. They are not the official post-rebuild split; the deterministic split strategy must be rerun on merged real events.

water_level.reference_shift_rule: TRAIN event median Tukey outer fences (Q1-3*IQR, Q3+3*IQR); FAIL only when the entire event min/max range lies outside a fence.
water_level.jump_rule: Hourly absolute changes are compared with the station TRAIN Tukey upper outer fence; non-consecutive timestamps are not differenced.
